# No error handling around database URL, engine creation, connection, or migration execution

The code invokes database_url(), engine_from_config(), connect(), and context.run_migrations() without try/except or retries. Failures from these operations will not be caught or handled within this module.

- `alembic/env.py` — `alembic.env.run_migrations_offline`
- `alembic/env.py` — `alembic.env.run_migrations_online`
